description: Fixed PED weights for the exposure-time-aware evidence pipeline. The main physical space contains composition and oxidation temperature; the protocol space contains six heat-treatment numerical variables plus oxidation exposure duration E_Time.
gain_aggregation: Within each source-aware fold, XGBoost gain is normalized to sum=1; normalized gains are then averaged across the five folds.
main_weight_formula: Elemental weights are derived from representative oxide-formation Gibbs free-energy affinity; oxidation temperature uses a fixed highest prior; all main-space weights are normalized to sum=1.
protocol_weight_formula: Weights for solu_temp, solu_time, middle_temp, middle_time, aging_temp, aging_time and E_Time are proportional to their mean normalized XGBoost gain across the five source-aware folds, then normalized to sum=1 within the protocol subspace.
usage_note: Reuse these fixed weights unchanged for pooled OOF, temporal, full-data calibration and prospective analyses. Fold-specific means/stds may be fit from each training evidence pool, but the weights themselves remain fixed.
